verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring collection runs is a fair axis for an API client, but the evidence shows no built-in scheduler, monitor, or recurring-run feature in Bruno. It only shows a CLI, Docker images and CI/CD integration, which would rely on external schedulers such as cron or CI pipelines. Those are user-side or host-platform workarounds, not Bruno's own capability, and they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
